findings.finding: Mandatory circle section contains only a radian hint; the degree/radian angular-measure row is below the facultative heading. This alone does not establish full conversion competence as compulsory J9 work.

The introduction explicitly treats general sine and cosine functions in radians; its account links this to unit-circle determination and periodic applications. This passage was omitted by the extraction restricted to topic-level mandatory tables.

Unit-circle sine/cosine and determining angles from trigonometric values are stated; the displayed geometric angle range is in degrees. The isolated inverse-angle row alone is not exact evidence for the whole radian variant.
